subject: prd/argus-unattended-drive
statement: When a proposal is classified, the lane classifier shall evaluate the deterministic floor first — versioned policy data naming the hard-gated classes (control-plane paths, governance documents, the risk policy and activation state themselves, the Argus authority contract and agent home) — and shall route HUMAN on any floor hit.
rationale: the non-negotiable floor; self-unlock and governance classes never ride AUTO
fit_criterion: 100% of floor-hit fixtures route HUMAN regardless of any other signal; the floor derives from the diff's paths and classes, never from author-declared metadata
